text: In early 2021, the City of Toronto's Social Development Finance and Administration, Research and Information Management Unit posted changes coming to its Neighbourhood Profiles that would expand the number of neighbourhoods recognized by the City from 140 to 158. This process has been undertaken to more accurately group and analyze census data, and allow other community agencies to do the same. The City had not reorganized its neighbourhoods since amalgamation. Names for new neighbourhoods selected in the process did not include input from Council or local councillors. As these names are the only comprehensive list of neighbourhood titles posted by the City, they are seen as "official" by many of those living in the community. In some cases, where new names failed to adequately consider neighbourhood history, community response has been negative.
Motion MM31.20 was withdrawn at City Council on April 7 and 8, 2021.
